title: Section 760.51 – Revise Section 760.51 to read as follows:
officialText:
(A) NPLFA Circuits. Where only non–power-limited fire alarm circuit conductors are in a raceway, the number of
conductors shall be determined in accordance with 300.17. The ampacity adjustment factors given in 310.15(C)(1)
shall apply if such conductors carry continuous load in excess of 10 percent of the ampacity of each conductor.
(B) DELETED.
(C) DELETED.
